# WTF Agency

> Battle Tested Creativity. AI First. Human Always.

WTF Agency is an independent creative agency founded in 2010. It combines senior strategy, creativity, production, data and artificial intelligence in operating systems built to help brands think, create, produce, move and learn faster.

## Core offer

- Brand Platform System
- Always-on Content System
- Launch System
- AI Production System
- Regional Rollout System
- Retail & E-commerce System
- Social & Culture System

The need defines the system, not the other way around.

## Experience

15+ years, 300+ campaigns, 30+ brands, 10+ countries and work across technology, automotive, beverages, consumer goods and other categories.

Selected experience includes Motorola, Ford, Honda, Absolut, Samsung, Bayer, Quilmes and regional brand launches across Latin America, the United States and Spain.
